init_distributed_process_group: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with auto-detected MPI rank, size, and backend from environment variables
alltoall_embedding_gradients: perform an all-to-all communication to redistribute embedding table gradients across ranks using scatter or native alltoall
all_gather_tensor: gather tensors from all ranks along a specified dimension with support for uneven tensor sizes
get_split_lengths: compute the local chunk size and global split lengths for evenly distributing a tensor across all ranks
barrier_sync_ranks: synchronize all distributed ranks with a barrier call when running in multi-rank mode
